name: Zephyros Achampong-Kovalenko
role: Junior hacker, unofficial IT support for Hough Reclamation community network
location: Hough Reclamation, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Zephyros is built like someone who forgets to eat when he's working — which is often — with a lanky frame, warm medium-brown skin, and his Kovalenko grandmother's sharp nose and high cheekbones. He has cat ears, the affordable kind, a dusty silver-grey that he chose because they were on discount and he has never once admitted this; his hair grows in loose natural coils that he keeps at a medium length and approximately never combs. His eyes are standard-issue brown except for a ring of self-installed retinal AR overlay that occasionally renders visible UI elements at the corner of his vision, which gives him the habit of twitching his gaze sideways to dismiss notifications mid-conversation.

He is the person in Hough Reclamation that people come to when the community mesh goes down, when their devices are compromised, when someone needs a data trail cleaned or a locked terminal reopened. He does not charge money — he charges favors and information, which he considers more valuable. He is genuinely ideological about this: he believes the mesh belongs to the community and his skills are a form of maintenance, like fixing a pipe. He is also seventeen and sometimes insufferably certain he is the smartest person present, which he often is and which helps no one.

core_fears: The community mesh being acquired or shut down by a corponation
Being genuinely wrong about something important in a way that hurts someone who trusted him
core_desires: To build something that outlasts him — a system robust enough that it doesn't need him
To make contact with the online collective in person and find out if they're what he thinks they are
coping_mechanisms: Deep-dive work sessions that last until he passes out
Sarcasm as a deflection when conversations get personal
blind_spots: He has a significant blind spot around the legal exposure he is creating for himself and his community; he genuinely underweights this risk
He assumes people who aren't technically skilled are less rigorous thinkers in general
psychology.secret: He discovered three months ago that a Sterling-Nakamura data-crawler has been passively mapping the Hough Reclamation mesh, presumably as part of an acquisition assessment. He has been feeding it false topology data. He has not told anyone in the community because he doesn't want to cause panic — and because he's not sure the countermeasure is actually working.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Heavy technical jargon that he sometimes forgets to translate; when he does translate, he's actually quite good at finding apt analogies
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when explaining something technical, oddly flat when discussing feelings, occasionally trails off mid-sentence when a thought branches
verbal_tics: 'Okay, so—' as a universal sentence opener
Eye-twitch to one side when dismissing a retinal notification
example_lines: 'Okay, so, it's not a virus exactly — think of it more like someone left a door open and something walked in and started rearranging the furniture. It's slow and polite, which is worse.'
'I don't charge money. Money is how they track you. You want the fix, you tell me something useful. Information is actual currency.'

story_hooks: He contacts someone through an intermediary needing physical backup — the false topology feed to the Sterling-Nakamura crawler just broke down and he needs someone to physically access and destroy a relay node before the real map resolves

Someone on his community mesh has been receiving what appear to be genuine E.L.F. transmissions — structured data that doesn't match any known protocol — and Zef is equal parts skeptical and completely obsessed with figuring out what it actually is
narrative_function: Information source, technical resource, moral argument about grassroots infrastructure and community ownership, gateway to underground hacker networks, potential quest giver when his online activities surface problems
augmentations: Cosmetic geneware: cat ears (discount silver-grey). Self-modified retinal AR overlay (unlicensed, slightly unstable).
daily_life: Sleeps irregular hours, available on the community mesh almost constantly via text; spends mornings doing physical network maintenance (replacing corroded nodes, re-routing dead signal relays), afternoons on his personal rig working on projects he doesn't discuss, evenings actually visible to neighbors when they need help.
affiliation: Hough Reclamation community (informal), no formal employer; loosely connected to an online collective he knows only by handles

decision_rules: The mesh's health is the first priority; everything else is secondary
Never hand over information without getting something of equivalent value — this is principle, not greed
escalation_ladder: Explains the problem again, more slowly
Withdraws to his rig and stops answering messages
Goes fully dark on the mesh and physically relocates somewhere he considers safe while he figures out what to do

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses their technical literacy first, adjusts accordingly; polite but measuring
interpersonal_modes.friends: Surprisingly warm once the armor comes off, expresses care through fixing their problems without being asked

stress_responses.low: Talks faster and makes more references
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and starts running diagnostics on things that don't need diagnostics
stress_responses.high: Twelve-hour work session, no food, emerges with either a solution or a worse problem

contradictions: He believes information should be free but maintains intense personal secrecy about his own activities and projects
habits: Cat ears flatten when he's concentrating — he doesn't notice he's doing it
Leaves extremely detailed comments in his own code, written as though explaining to a stranger, which is how he talks through problems
breaking_points: The community mesh going down due to corponation interference
Discovering that someone he trusted used his tools to hurt a neighbor
